rows.name: TDI-polyether / MBOCA 70A
rows.shrinkNotes: Hot-cast in 100-120 C metal mold; most of the shrink is thermal contraction of the elastomer (CTE ~1.5-2.0e-4 /K) from mold to room temperature plus ~0.3-0.5% chemical shrink. Supplier data rarely published; prove out on first article and leave cavities steel-safe.
rows.cureBasis: Demold time at mold temperature for 6-12 mm section

postCure.notes: 16 h at 100 C typical for TDI/MBOCA systems; full properties after ~7 days at room temperature.

rows.pressureNotes: Press only clamps the closed mold against hydrostatic head and reaction expansion; no flow pressure needed. Pour-then-close: close before gel (within pot life).

flash.moldStyle: closed pour mold, metal-to-metal land, risers/vents at high points

rows.ventingNotes: Liquid traps air under every downward-facing surface: orient part so the pour enters low and air exits high; risers/vent holes 1-3 mm at all high points; degas prepolymer at 1-5 mbar before mixing.
rows.releaseAgent: Semi-permanent or silicone/wax release (e.g. Chem-Trend, Stoner urethane releases); PTFE or nickel-PTFE coating for production. Use silicone-free release if parts are bonded/painted.
rows.moistureNotes: Isocyanate + water -> CO2 bubbles and soft spots. Keep prepolymer under dry N2, molds preheated and dry, inserts degreased and primed.
rows.corrosionNotes: Not corrosive; liquid isocyanate bonds strongly to bare/unreleased metal.

moldCompat.plating: none needed; optional electroless nickel or PTFE-impregnated hard anodize for release
moldCompat.notes: 100-120 C mold and <150 psi: aluminium 6061-T651/7075-T651 is the normal choice; steel inserts only for thin/fragile cores and wear features.

rows.hazards: MBOCA (MOCA) is a suspected human carcinogen; molten curative at 110-120 C; TDI vapour. Use ventilation, gloves, low-free (LF) prepolymers where possible.
rows.notes: Low-NCO prepolymer (about 2.5-3% NCO): more viscous, long pot life, slow green strength.
